headline: RBI: ₹10,800 crore State Government Securities switch auction on 26 Nov 2026
summary_points: Five States (MP, Punjab, Rajasthan, Tamil Nadu, UP) will switch SDLs for longer-dated SGS via auction for an aggregate ₹10,800 crore (FV).
Bids on e-Kuber on 26 Nov 2026, 10:30 AM to 11:30 AM; multiple-price auction; results same day; settlement on 27 Nov 2026 (T+1).
Source security price must equal the previous working day's FBIL closing price; minimum bid ₹10,000 and multiples thereof.
who_is_affected: Banks, primary dealers and other market participants holding the listed State Development Loans eligible to bid on e-Kuber.
action_required: Eligible participants should place bids on e-Kuber between 10:30 AM and 11:30 AM on 26 November 2026, following the operational guidelines in the Annex.

social.linkedin:
RBI has announced a conversion/switch auction of State Government Securities for an aggregate ₹10,800 crore (face value), involving Madhya Pradesh, Punjab, Rajasthan, Tamil Nadu and Uttar Pradesh.

Key details:
- Auction date: 26 November 2026, bidding on e-Kuber from 10:30 AM to 11:30 AM
- Format: multiple-price auction; results announced the same day
- Settlement: 27 November 2026 (T+1)
- Source security price must match the previous working day's FBIL closing price
- Minimum bid ₹10,000 and in multiples of ₹10,000

States may accept offers for less than the notified amount or reject any or all offers. Though broadly cash neutral, there is fund settlement for net accrued interest and rounding-off of destination security face value.

Treasury teams and investors in SDLs should review the security-wise details and the Annex on operational guidelines.

Please verify with the official RBI press release (2026-2027/1539) before acting.
